Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of MSI Thin 15 (B12UCX)?

The MSI Thin 15 (B12UCX) features a 45W TGP rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 4GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 64GB) and 1x M.2 NVMe slot + 1x 2.5" SATA HDD slot. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

MSI Thin 15 (B12UCX) scores 8.4/10 for software engineering. Its Intel Core i5-12450H (8 Cores: 4P + 4E, 12 Threads, up to 4.4 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
